Its combat capabilities surpass those of metallic shields, and it can deflect Guardian Scout beams.|Inventory|BotW}} Guardian Shields++ go unnamed in {{AoC}}. ==Location and Uses== ==={{BotW|-}}=== {{BotW Item Properties/Store |type = Shield |strength = 42 |durability = 20 |flammable = No |magnetic = No |buoyant = Yes |conductive = No |guardian = Yes |throw = Yes |throw effect = }} {{Compendium/Extract|Guardian Shield++}} Guardian Shields++ are [[Shield]]s that can be found in "A Major Test of Strength" [[Ancient Shrine]]s, where they are used by [[Guardian Scout IV|Guardian Scouts IV]]. They can also be found in [[Treasure Chest]]s that spawn when the {{BotW}} Series [[Guardian]] [[amiibo]] is scanned with the [[Amiibo (Ability)|amiibo]] [[Rune]]. They are upgraded [[Guardian Shield]]s that have had their output levels boosted to the maximum. Guardian Shields++ belong to the [[Guardian Gear]] equipment archetype.{{Cite Book|quote= |book= CaC |publisher= |page= 175}} Their combat abilities are said to surpass those of metallic Shields, and they are capable of deflecting the beams of [[Guardian Scout]]s and other Guardians. As they are made from [[Ancient Technology]], Guardian Shields++ will float if they are dropped in [[Water (Terrain)|Water]]. In addition, they will not burn if they are exposed to [[Fire]] or a [[Scorching Climate]], and they will not conduct [[Electricity]] or attract [[Lightning]] during [[Thunderstorm]]s. They also cannot be manipulated by the [[Magnesis]] [[Rune]]. {{BotW Shield Parameters |ActorName = "Weapon_Shield_015" |Life = 20 |GuardPower = 42 |SharpWeaponAddLifeMin = 3 |SharpWeaponAddLifeMax = 6 |SharpWeaponAddGuardMin = 3 |SharpWeaponAddGuardMax = 6 |PoweredSharpAddLifeMin = 7 |PoweredSharpAddLifeMax = 12 |PoweredSharpAddGuardMin = 7 |PoweredSharpAddGuardMax = 12 |RideBreakRatio = 1.0 |MirrorLevel = 1 |SurfingFriction = 1.0 }} ==Other Appearances== ==={{AoC|-}}=== {{Noncanon|Start}} Guardian Shields++ can be wielded by [[Link]] in conjunction with [[Guardian Sword++|Guardian Swords++]]. {{Noncanon|End}} ==Nomenclature== {{Nomenclature}} ==See Also== {{See Also| * Ancient Technology * Guardian Gear * Guardian Shield * Guardian Shield+ * Shield }} {{Ref}} {{Categories |Ancient Technology, Guardian Gear, Shields |items= BotW, AoC }}
